mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM READING_SEAT_RESERVATIONS R JOIN READING_ROOM_SEATS S ON S.SEAT_ID = R.SEAT_ID JOIN READING_ROOMS RR ON RR.READING_ROOM_ID = S.READING_ROOM_ID WHERE R.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND R.STATUS IN ('USING', 'RESERVED') AND R.START_TIME <= CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AND R.END_TIME > CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY R.START_TIME DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT
FROM READING_SEAT_RESERVATIONS R JOIN READING_ROOM_SEATS S ON S.SEAT_ID = R.SEAT_ID JOIN READING_ROOMS RR ON RR.READING_ROOM_ID = S.READING_ROOM_ID WHERE R.RESERVATION_ID = #{reservationId} AND R.STATUS IN ('USING', 'RESERVED') AND R.START_TIME <= CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AND R.END_TIME > CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)

SELECT ROOM_ID, #{reservationId} AS MY_RESERVATION_ID, CASE WHEN INITIATOR_RES_ID = #{reservationId} THEN TARGET_RES_ID ELSE INITIATOR_RES_ID END AS TARGET_RESERVATION_ID, STATUS, CREATED_AT FROM SEAT_CHAT_ROOMS WHERE NVL(STATUS, 'ACTIVE') = 'ACTIVE' AND ( (INITIATOR_RES_ID = #{reservationId} AND TARGET_RES_ID = #{targetReservationId}) OR (INITIATOR_RES_ID = #{targetReservationId} AND TARGET_RES_ID = #{reservationId}) ) FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_SEAT_CHAT_ROOMS.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO SEAT_CHAT_ROOMS ( ROOM_ID, INITIATOR_RES_ID, TARGET_RES_ID, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{roomId}, #{myReservationId}, #{targetReservationId}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'ACTIVE'), SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT CR.ROOM_ID, #{reservationId} AS MY_RESERVATION_ID, TR.RESERVATION_ID AS TARGET_RESERVATION_ID, TR.SEAT_ID AS TARGET_SEAT_ID, S.READING_ROOM_ID AS TARGET_READING_ROOM_ID, RR.ROOM_NAME AS TARGET_ROOM_NAME, S.SEAT_NUMBER AS TARGET_SEAT_NUMBER, CR.STATUS, CR.CREATED_AT, LM.MESSAGE_TEXT AS LAST_MESSAGE_TEXT, LM.CREATED_AT AS LAST_MESSAGE_AT FROM SEAT_CHAT_ROOMS CR JOIN READING_SEAT_RESERVATIONS TR ON TR.RESERVATION_ID = CASE WHEN CR.INITIATOR_RES_ID = #{reservationId} THEN CR.TARGET_RES_ID ELSE CR.INITIATOR_RES_ID END JOIN READING_ROOM_SEATS S ON S.SEAT_ID = TR.SEAT_ID JOIN READING_ROOMS RR ON RR.READING_ROOM_ID = S.READING_ROOM_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ROOM_ID, MESSAGE_TEXT, CREATED_AT FROM ( SELECT ROOM_ID, MESSAGE_TEXT, CREATED_AT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ROOM_ID ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, MESSAGE_ID DESC ) AS RN FROM SEAT_CHAT_MESSAGES ) WHERE RN = 1 ) LM ON LM.ROOM_ID = CR.ROOM_ID WHERE CR.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND NVL(CR.STATUS, 'ACTIVE') = 'ACTIVE' AND TR.STATUS IN ('USING', 'RESERVED') AND TR.START_TIME <= CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AND TR.END_TIME > CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AND (CR.INITIATOR_RES_ID = #{reservationId} OR CR.TARGET_RES_ID = #{reservationId})

SELECT CR.ROOM_ID, #{reservationId} AS MY_RESERVATION_ID, TR.RESERVATION_ID AS TARGET_RESERVATION_ID, TR.SEAT_ID AS TARGET_SEAT_ID, S.READING_ROOM_ID AS TARGET_READING_ROOM_ID, RR.ROOM_NAME AS TARGET_ROOM_NAME, S.SEAT_NUMBER AS TARGET_SEAT_NUMBER, CR.STATUS, CR.CREATED_AT, LM.MESSAGE_TEXT AS LAST_MESSAGE_TEXT, LM.CREATED_AT AS LAST_MESSAGE_AT FROM SEAT_CHAT_ROOMS CR JOIN READING_SEAT_RESERVATIONS TR ON TR.RESERVATION_ID = CASE WHEN CR.INITIATOR_RES_ID = #{reservationId} THEN CR.TARGET_RES_ID ELSE CR.INITIATOR_RES_ID END JOIN READING_ROOM_SEATS S ON S.SEAT_ID = TR.SEAT_ID JOIN READING_ROOMS RR ON RR.READING_ROOM_ID = S.READING_ROOM_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ROOM_ID, MESSAGE_TEXT, CREATED_AT FROM ( SELECT ROOM_ID, MESSAGE_TEXT, CREATED_AT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ROOM_ID ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, MESSAGE_ID DESC ) AS RN FROM SEAT_CHAT_MESSAGES ) WHERE RN = 1 ) LM ON LM.ROOM_ID = CR.ROOM_ID WHERE NVL(CR.STATUS, 'ACTIVE') = 'ACTIVE' AND TR.STATUS IN ('USING', 'RESERVED') AND TR.START_TIME <= CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AND TR.END_TIME > CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AND (CR.INITIATOR_RES_ID = #{reservationId} OR CR.TARGET_RES_ID = #{reservationId}) ORDER BY NVL(LM.CREATED_AT, CR.CREATED_AT) DESC
SELECT MESSAGE_ID, ROOM_ID, SENDER_RES_ID, SENDER_MEMBER_ID, MESSAGE_TEXT, IS_READ, CREATED_AT FROM SEAT_CHAT_MESSAGES WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT ASC, MESSAGE_ID ASC
